1.12.2.1.12.2-1.0.0:
First release.
Measures time spent on each server and world, telling real play time apart from AFK time.
Open it from Esc → Statistics, from /played, or from a key you assign in Options → Controls.
1.12.2.1.12.2-1.1.0:
Adds Minecraft 1.20.1 (Forge, Fabric) and 1.21.1 (NeoForge, Fabric).
Activity is now also read by polling the input devices each tick, which no longer misses a player whose input events another mod cancels.
A brief focus steal by another application no longer splits your session.
On 1.20 and later the settings live in actuallyplayed.properties; there is no settings screen there.
